bifrost: bifrost_app::locale, bifrost_app::coding, bifrost_app::attributed, bifrost_ui::calendar, bifrost_ui::format, bifrost_ui::table, bifrost_ui::diff, bifrost_ui::geometry
summary: Locale-aware number, date, byte, measurement and list formatting, Gregorian calendar math, sort descriptors and Codable-style coding exist. Apps get no predicate or expression engine, no regex or natural-language API, no time zones, and no full Data/Decimal/UUID/IndexSet type family (Rust std covers some of it).

features.apple: NSNumber, Data, Decimal, UUID, NSValue, CGRect-like geometry (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/numbers-data-and-basic-values)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/geometry.rs (Rect, EdgeInsets); Rust std types for numbers, bytes and ids
features.note: geometry types exist; no NSNumber, Decimal or NSValue wrappers, and no UUID type in the SDK

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/text.rs (editing ranges), springboard/sdk/src/attributed.rs, springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (data detectors), springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (word ranges), springboard/ui/src/fuzzy.rs
features.note: range editing, rich text, detectors and spellcheck exist; no regular expression API and no linguistic tagging for apps

features.apple: NSArray, NSDictionary, NSSet, NSOrderedSet, IndexSet, NSCountedSet
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/diff.rs (ordered collection diff); Rust std Vec, HashMap, HashSet
features.note: std collections cover the basics; no IndexSet, counted or ordered set types, and no key-value coding

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/calendar.rs (Gregorian Date, days_in_month, is_leap, weekday math); springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (explicit tz_offset in DateFormatter)
features.note: Gregorian only, no time-zone database, no DateInterval; docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Locale and localization' lists these gaps

features.apple: Measurement, Unit, UnitLength, UnitMass, UnitTemperature, conversions
features.note: length, mass and temperature only; no other dimensions, no user-defined units

features.apple: NumberFormatter, DateFormatter, RelativeDateTimeFormatter, ByteCountFormatter, MeasurementFormatter, ListFormatter
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (NumberFormatter, DateFormatter, relative_date_time, byte_count, measurement, list); springboard/ui/src/format.rs (English-only shell formatters)
features.note: en and is only; no stringsdict plurals, no duration, person-name, interval or ISO8601 formatters; shell code still uses English-only format.rs
sort descriptors for tables exist; no predicate or expression engine
reads .strings tables; en and is built in
plist and Codable-style encoding including dates; JSON and archiving belong to the Archives section covered elsewhere

features.apple: Progress reporting types listed on the landing page
protocol listed on the landing page

gaps: Regular expression and natural-language text analysis API
IndexSet, ordered and counted sets, Decimal, UUID, NSNumber wrappers
More unit dimensions and formatter types (duration, person name, ISO8601); languages beyond en and is
